title: Logpoint draft validation: publication-safe stills
status: Prepared locally. No publication performed by this export.

source10_context.provenance: Recording interval and normal stop are supplied by the recording operator; not inferred from screenshot filesystem timestamps. These are screenshot derivatives, not frames extracted from the motion recording.
source10_context.submission: No submission occurred, according to the supplied interaction record.

accessibility_scope: A separate DOM inspection reportedly found that the Line control lacked an accessible name. These screenshots cannot independently prove accessible-name semantics, an absent programmatic error association, or a WCAG violation. This package does not label the observation as a confirmed accessibility failure.
preservation: Only this new publication folder was written. Originals and prior frozen09/V6 media were not edited or replaced.
filesystem_timestamp_caveat: Filesystem UTC modification times may reflect copying or export. They are not independently verified capture timestamps, nor UI-event, ingestion, or trace-event times.

assets.caption: An unsubmitted logpoint draft shows the unbalanced template QA {quantity with a red outline and a pale, disabled-looking Start Debug Session control. The supplied recording sequence places this state after focus moved away from the template.
